objective: Coordinate complete synthetic PB4T departmental proposals into zero-collision qualified weekly allocations, enforce explicit fatigue and occurrence constraints, compute loading, and distinguish invalid, impossible and exhausted search. Optimize the bounded collision objective only; retain all mandatory occurrences and expose review boundaries.

invocation.input: JSON object with exactly action and record, plus allocations only for validate. action is required string inspect, negotiate or validate. record uses the prepared invented PB4T grammar: required schemaVersion integer 1, fixtureId nonblank string, provenance nonblank string containing Synthetic; week {start: ISO UTC Monday midnight string,timezone:"UTC",horizonMinutes:10080,intervalSemantics:"half-open"}; departments array {departmentId:ID,name:string,priority:positive integer,tieOrder:positive integer}; personnel array {id:ID,name:string,departmentId:ID,qualifications:[{role:nonblank string,validFrom:integer,validUntil:integer}],availability:[[integer,integer]]}; resources array {id:ID,name:string,capacity:1,availability:[[integer,integer]]}; operationalWindows:[[integer,integer]]; fixedDuties:[{id:ID,personnelId:ID,startMinute:integer,endMinute:integer}]; policy {synthetic:true,minimumRestMinutes:nonnegative integer,maxDutyMinutesPerUtcDay:nonnegative integer,maxDutyMinutesPerWeek:nonnegative integer,countTrainingAndWatches:true,restAppliesBetweenEveryDistinctDutyInterval:true,dailyBudgetWindow:"UTC midnight; split crossing intervals",weeklyBudgetWindow:"[0,10080); clip crossing intervals",qualificationMustCoverEntireDrill:true}; drills:[{id:ID,title:nonblank string,departmentId:ID,durationMinutes:positive integer,mandatory:true,requiredRoles:[{role:nonblank string,count:positive integer}],eligiblePersonnelIds:[ID],resourceIds:[ID],allowedStartMinutes:[nonnegative integer],preferredStartMinute:nonnegative integer,proposedPersonnelIds:[ID],requirementId:ID}]; recurrenceRequirements:[{id:ID,lastCompletionMinute:integer,ruleKind:"explicit-window-obligations",referenceIntervalMinutes:positive integer,occurrences:[{id:ID,releaseMinute:integer,deadlineMinute:integer,requiredCount:1}]}]; search {maxNodes:integer 0..200000,candidateOrder:"department priority, then drill ID; preferred start first then ascending allowed start; personnel IDs ascending",objective:nonblank string}; review {state:"pending-review" or "locally-reviewed",revision:positive integer,realApproval:false}. ID is nonblank ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, <=80 characters. All fields above required; no nulls, omitted defaults, optional drills or unknown fields at any nesting. Arrays may be empty except departments, operationalWindows, requiredRoles, allowedStartMinutes, and each drill eligiblePersonnelIds. qualifications may be empty. Empty personnel/resources/drills/requirements and empty availability are allowed. Unique IDs per entity list; occurrence IDs globally unique; no duplicate set members/roles/starts. Intervals have exactly two integers start<end. Negative minutes allowed only for qualifications, history, fixed duties and occurrence bounds. Current availability/operational windows lie in [0,10080]. Every drill has one matching in-week occurrence of same id under its requirement; every in-week occurrence has a drill. Starts may be outside its due window: this is infeasible rather than a schema error. preferredStartMinute must belong to allowedStartMinutes. Proposed crew must be a subset of eligible IDs; it may be inadequately qualified. Foreign keys must resolve. Limits: 24 drills, 200 personnel, 40 departments/resources/requirements, 100 starts per drill, 200 occurrences, 200 fixed duties, all integers absolute value <=1000000 except revision <=1000000. Maximum JSON request 100000 UTF-8 bytes. For validate, allocations is a required array with exactly one entry per drill: {drillId:ID,startMinute:nonnegative integer,endMinute:nonnegative integer,personnelIds:[ID],resourceIds:[ID]}; IDs resolve, no duplicates; allocation can violate constraints and is then reported as conflicts. Input review is descriptive only, never confers authority.
invocation.output: Exactly {status,error,result}. status is "feasible", "conflicts", "infeasible", "search-exhausted" or "invalid-input". error is null except invalid-input (string). result is null on invalid-input, infeasible and search-exhausted. Otherwise result is exactly {allocations,initialCollisions,collisions,violations,coverage,loads,negotiation,metrics,realApproval}. allocations uses validate entry shape. Collision = {drillIds:[two duty/drill IDs],kind:"personnel" or "resource",id:ID,overlap:[start,end]}. initialCollisions uses the preferred starts and proposed crews, independent of action. violations = [{code:string,ids:[ID]}] deduplicated. coverage = {dueInWeek:integer,scheduledWithinDeadline:integer,missed:integer,historicallyOverdue:integer,overdueIds:[ID],futureIds:[ID]}. loads = [{personnelId:ID,trainingMinutes:integer,weeklyDutyMinutes:integer,dailyTrainingMinutes:[7 integers],dailyDutyMinutes:[7 integers]}], including every person and zero loads. negotiation = [{departmentId:ID,drillId:ID,proposal:{startMinute:integer,personnelIds:[ID]},counterproposal:{startMinute:integer,personnelIds:[ID]},decision:"retain" or "counterproposal"}]; empty for inspect and validate. metrics = {initialCollisionCount:integer,remainingCollisionCount:integer,hardViolationCount:integer,movedDrillIds:[ID],trainingMinutes:integer,weeklyDutyMinutes:integer,objectiveValue:integer,objectiveLowerBound:0,searchBudget:integer}. realApproval always false. No additional response fields. HTTP POST returns 200 for these envelopes, including domain errors. Invalid JSON bytes return {status:"invalid-input",error:"Malformed JSON.",result:null}; oversized input returns error "Input exceeds 100000 bytes.". Transport failures outside this protocol appear visibly in UI and retain last valid board.
rules: Validation precedence: reject byte size, JSON syntax, envelope/action/record schema, duplicate IDs, reversed intervals, missing policy fields, dangling references, recurrence mapping, then cross-reference set consistency, then fixed-history policy violations, then perform action. Proposed-crew subset, preferred-start membership, and allocation coverage consistency are cross-reference checks after dangling-reference checks; failures use "Invalid input schema.". Schema validation temporarily permits missing policy keys and reversed interval endpoints so they receive their more specific later errors. Within a phase traverse fields in order declared in input; traverse arrays in input order. Unknown fields or malformed field types/unsupported values use "Invalid input schema."; unknown/missing action uses "Unknown action.". No partially computed response on invalid input.

Duplicate drill ID X uses "Duplicate drill ID X."; all other duplicate identities/set entries use "Duplicate ID X.". Reversed operational interval uses "Operational window start must be less than end."; other reversed intervals use "Interval start must be less than end.". Missing policy key K uses "Missing required policy K." in declared key order. Dangling person/resource uses "Unknown personnel ID X." / "Unknown resource ID X."; other dangling references use "Unknown reference X.". Inconsistent in-week drill/occurrence mapping uses "Invalid recurrence mapping.". Fixed duties violating overlap, rest, daily or weekly policy use "Fixed duties violate fatigue policy.". Replace X/K with supplied ID/key, no quoting.

All intervals are half-open UTC minute offsets from week.start. A drill is inside one ship operational window and inside one availability interval of each assigned person and resource; end may equal boundary. All resources are exclusive capacity one. All assigned resources must equal drill.resourceIds as sets. Drill end equals start+duration; start must be an allowed start and drill entirely within [0,10080). No unmodeled history or operational policy is inferred.

Each required role slot must be filled by a different assigned eligible person holding that role throughout [start,end): validFrom<=start and validUntil>=end. Exactly sum(count) crew, no surplus people. A person cannot fill two slots. Test existence of a complete distinct role matching; do not require role order to equal personnel ID order.

All training intervals and fixed duties count as duty. For every pair of duties of one person: reject overlap, else require gap>=minimumRestMinutes, including pre-week watches. Never count overlap as an additional rest violation. Sum duty duration separately per UTC day (including negative days in history) by midnight splitting; enforce maxDutyMinutesPerUtcDay. Weekly duty clips every duty to [0,10080) and enforces maxDutyMinutesPerWeek. Do not merge overlapping intervals to hide violations.

Occurrences with 0<=deadlineMinute<=10080 are due this week, including cross-boundary releases; require matching drill start>=release and end<=deadline. deadline<0 is historical: fulfilled iff lastCompletionMinute lies in [release,deadline] inclusive; otherwise historically overdue. deadline>10080 is future and remains visible in futureIds. Require release<deadline. Explicit occurrence list is authoritative expansion into occurrence IDs; referenceIntervalMinutes is descriptive only. No SFTRM rule is inferred. ScheduledWithinDeadline counts due occurrences whose matching allocation meets release/deadline (independent of other validity); missed=due-scheduled. Historical overdue warns, but does not invalidate current-week feasibility.

inspect constructs allocations from preferredStartMinute and proposedPersonnelIds. validate evaluates the supplied allocations. Their status is feasible iff violations empty, otherwise conflicts; they never search or alter submitted allocations. negotiate runs bounded depth-first search and returns the first complete feasible allocation; returns infeasible only after complete finite candidate exhaustion, search-exhausted if another attempt would exceed maxNodes. Never return partial or incumbent allocations as complete.

Search order: departments ascending (priority,tieOrder,departmentId), then drills lexicographic ID within department. For each drill preferred start first then remaining starts ascending. For each start enumerate all distinct eligible personnel subsets of required total size in lexicographic order of sorted ID arrays, retaining only subsets admitting role matching, qualification validity, and whole-interval person/resource/ship availability and recurrence. Search counts one node per such locally eligible (start,crew) candidate tried against current partial allocations/fixed duties; reject interassignment hard constraints then backtrack. Completion is checked before budget exhaustion; no candidates at a depth means infeasible there without consuming a node. If maxNodes=0 and drills nonempty, immediately search-exhausted after valid input/history, even if locally impossible. Empty drills yields feasible empty allocation.

Collision entries: each overlapping pair of allocations or fixed duties sharing a person emits one personnel entry per shared person; each overlapping pair of allocations sharing a resource emits one resource entry per shared resource. Fixed duties occupy no resources. Pair IDs sorted; overlap is exact intersection. initialCollisions includes immutable duties and all preferred proposals. Returned collisions uses chosen/supplied allocations and fixed duties.

Violations: collision generates code "personnel-overlap" or "resource-overlap" with ids=[sharedID,sorted pair IDs]. Other codes: "allowed-start", "duration", "operational-window", "resources", "qualification", "recurrence" use ids=[drillId]; "personnel-availability" / "resource-availability" use ids=[drillId,entityId]; "rest" uses ids=[personnelId,sorted duty pair IDs]; "daily-duty" uses ids=[personnelId,decimal UTC day offset as string]; "weekly-duty" uses ids=[personnelId]. Invalid crew size/eligibility/matching all produce one qualification violation per drill. Day offset floor(minute/1440) can be negative; violations.ids are strings, including day offset. Negotiate accepts only zero violations.

loads sum each assigned person drill duration, clipping to displayed week; dailyTrainingMinutes splits training per seven days Monday first; dailyDutyMinutes includes watches; trainingMinutes is sum dailyTrainingMinutes; weeklyDutyMinutes is sum dailyDutyMinutes. metrics totals are sums over loads. Initial/final collision counts count entries, not distinct pairs. hardViolationCount=violations.length. movedDrillIds includes any drill whose start or personnel set differs from proposal. objectiveValue=remainingCollisionCount; minimize collisions subject all mandatory occurrences and all hard constraints. Nonnegative lower bound is 0; any feasible result attains the bounded collision objective. No claim of minimal moved drills, balanced staffing, globally optimal roster or optimality outside supplied candidates.

Negotiation is computed for every drill only after successful negotiate: each owning department independently supplies its original preferred start and proposed crew, then receives the shared-constraint counterproposal. decision retain iff both start and personnel set unchanged, else counterproposal. UI must explain observed collision constraints from computed initialCollisions and changed assignment, not fabricate free-text reasons or a model transcript.

Array ordering: allocations by drillId lexical; personnelIds/resourceIds and movedDrillIds/overdueIds/futureIds lexical. collisions and initialCollisions by (drillIds[0],drillIds[1],kind,id), with kind personnel before resource; drillIds pair lexical. violations by (code, concatenated ids joined with /), ids positions as above (do not sort subject positions); loads by personnelId lexical; negotiation by department search order then drillId. Daily arrays fixed Monday..Sunday. Compare strings by ASCII codepoint, no locale sorting.

All response values deterministic; never echo fixture expected answers, input review state or prose search objective as calculations. Runtime and interface call the same compute.mjs export, backed by lib/pb4t.mjs and reused/extended pack. Missing model: none required or used. Invalid, infeasible or exhausted results abstain with result:null; UI preserves prior valid board and displays current failure, never implies compliance or approval.

Cancellation is transport lifecycle, not an action or successful computational envelope. server.mjs runs invocation in compute-worker.mjs and terminates that worker when the requesting connection closes before completion. UI AbortController cancellation and request-generation guard discard stale responses. UI says "Cancelled; last valid board retained."; no cancelled JSON result is fabricated. Standalone Node tests may call compute.mjs directly.

capabilities.description: Shared deterministic departmental negotiation, hard-constraint validation, distinct crew selection, fatigue/history, explicit occurrence expansion and numeric loading. Feasible outputs achieve collision objective lower bound zero; impossible/exhausted inputs abstain.
